title: Signed-payload strkey with a 1-byte inner payload, the shortest valid P address (69 characters)
why: The shortest P address is as long as an M address; a reader that sizes P columns from the SEP's 32-byte examples, or that strips the three zero padding bytes, loses or rejects it.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.signed-payload-1-byte.json. The text was encoded from the stated payload with an independent SEP-0023 encoder (version byte, payload, CRC16-XModem little-endian, RFC 4648 base32 without padding) and decoded back by the same rules; no SDK output was used. Executed in every probe column as vector 9S4 (evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json).
